material.description: scripts/dev/stage.sh vs pages.yml 'Lay out the site': stage.sh keeps scenarios/*/tools, builds no packs/latest.json, writes ref local. Acceptance: both call one shared layout script (scripts/layout-site.sh) so they cannot drift. Witness: diff -r of stage output against the pages site-expected artifact limited to tracked inputs is empty.
